checks.evidence: Password-only then direct request for account pages is not tested. The AAL1 test (title: AAL1 ile hesap erişiminin reddedilmesi, step 2) denies access after a password-only login, but it does not request account pages directly or check that no information is returned.

invented: Reference to NIST SP 800-63B-4 as the standard supported (the requirement cites 800-63A-4 §5.2)
Specific authenticator examples such as OTP + password, FIDO2/WebAuthn key and biometrics
AAL1 attempt may be accepted or the user redirected to step up to AAL2/3, with a specific error message about requiring AAL2/3
